The '''centrifugal debris extractor''' was a component of a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] that acted to prevent debris from entering the [[Engine/Legends|engine]] compartment. A high RPM deflection cone and particle scoops combined to prevent debris impacting the performance of the fighter, especially during [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheric]] flight. The centrifugal debris extractor was an integral part of [[Incom Corporation/Legends|Incom Corporation's]] [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighter]].<ref name="SWS" />
